title: GrantExtendScope
description: The scope of grant.extend (docs/design/m0/14 N6/P6; 04 "Grants"): an atomic replacement of the live grant replaces by a fresh grant, under an id the client mints (grt_…, which must not exist), for the same grantee. One command revokes the old grant, creates the new one and records grant.replaced/v1 binding the old id to the complete new grant (and so to its approval). The grantee, valid_from, issued_by and approval are never the caller's: the grantee is the old grant's, and the rest are set as for grant.create. A supervisor's grant.extend is a human-policy proposal bound to the old grant's state, never confirmed by its grantee.

replaces.description: The live grant this one replaces.

expires_at.description: Required: every grant expires, after the time it is applied.
